title: Workplace Cafe Management Program: Points of Basis on Counting Suspended Days
content:
**Which calendar days count as suspended time when a standby charge is raised on a Workplace Cafe Management Program contract?**

That turns on what the contract's service request log shows on the day the charge is raised, and three answers cover the field.

**Where an approved resumption request asks service back after the day the pause began?**

Where a resumption request stands approved on the contract and the day it asked service to return falls after the day the latest approved suspension request asked service to stop, the suspended days counted are the calendar days from the day service was asked to stop to the day it was asked to return, both days counted.

**Where an approved resumption request asks service back on or before the day the pause began?**

Where a resumption request stands approved on the contract and the day it asked service to return falls on or before the day the latest approved suspension request asked service to stop, the suspended days counted are the calendar days from the day service was asked to stop to the day the charge is raised.

**Where nothing standing on the contract asks service back at all?**

Where no resumption request stands approved on the contract, the suspended days counted are the suspended calendar days standing against the current contract year.

**Which records settle the answer?**

The approved suspension requests and approved resumption requests standing on the contract's service request log; the day the latest approved suspension request asked service to stop; the day the approved resumption request asked service to return; and the suspended calendar days standing against the current contract year.

**How does the counting run on hypothetical days?**

On hypothetical dates where the latest approved suspension request asked service to stop on 2026-03-04 and an approved resumption request asked service to return on 2026-03-20, the day of return falls after the day of stopping, and the calendar days from 2026-03-04 to 2026-03-20, both days counted, are 17. On hypothetical dates where that approved resumption request instead asked service to return on 2026-03-04 itself, the day of return falls on or before the day of stopping, and with the charge raised on 2026-04-02 the calendar days from the day service was asked to stop to the day the charge is raised are 29.
